title: Stoker’s Natural 12oz Long Cut Chewing Tobacco
description:
Stoker’s Natural 12oz Long Cut Chewing Tobacco

Stoker’s Natural 12oz Long Cut Chewing Tobacco is a product base on long tobacco. The fact that the tobacco is long cut makes it easier pack and pinch, while staying together better in your mouth. Stoker’s Natural 12oz Long Cut Tobacco is manufacture by National Tobacco Company and has a smooth tobacco flavor. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compare to similar chewing tobacco products. Chewing tobacco can also be experience in plug and loose leaf. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Stoker’s brand page.
